clue.text: Firearm as wedding security device?

parts.note: a wedding is a match, a marriage
a lock is a device that keeps a door secure

explanation.surface: A gun is jokingly offered as the thing that keeps a marriage secure, as in a shotgun wedding.
explanation.definitionFit: An early musket fired by a slow-burning cord brought down onto the powder pan.

clue.text: Drain kitty to obtain battery-driven vehicle

parts.note: to milk something is to drain it of resources
a float is a fund of cash, like a kitty

explanation.surface: Someone empties the petty cash to buy an electric car.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain this electric van delivered bottled milk to doorsteps.
explanation.definitionFit: The quiet electric delivery van of British milkmen ran on batteries.

clue.text: Use bribery, say, in Florida resort

indicators.note: say signals the word is to be heard spoken, in a non-rhotic accent

parts.note: to tamper with someone, as with a witness, can mean bribing them

explanation.surface: A corruption scandal at a Florida resort.
explanation.definitionFit: A city on Florida's Gulf coast, popular with holidaymakers.

clue.text: Heather supports help for administration

indicators.note: in a down clue, a word that supports another sits below it

parts.note: a hand is help, as in lend a hand
ling is a common heather

explanation.surface: A heather plant props up an aid to good management.
explanation.definitionFit: Management or treatment of a matter, as in the dealing with a case.

clue.text: More chars perhaps needed? Yes, if you do this

definitions.text: More chars perhaps needed? Yes, if you do this

parts.words: More chars perhaps needed? Yes, if you do this
parts.note: chars are not cleaning ladies but char fish: taking too many from the water leaves stocks short

explanation.surface: A household short of cleaners is told it has only itself to blame.
explanation.definitionFit: To deplete a fish stock by catching too much.

clue.text: Destiny of many taking on Times puzzle?

indicators.note: taking on means the thousand letter is joined on to what follows

parts.note: K stands for a thousand, so many

indicators.note: puzzle suggests the letters of Times are muddled

explanation.surface: Lots of people seem fated to tackle the Times crossword.
explanation.definitionFit: A Turkish-derived word for fate.

clue.text: Derby's reported buffets

definitions.meaning: said aloud, Derby's sounds like 'derbies', old slang for handcuffs
buffets are blows with the hand

explanation.surface: A news item about what a Derby has been reported to dish out.
explanation.walkthrough: The first half works by sound on the clue word itself: 'Derby's' said aloud is 'derbies', slang for handcuffs, shortened to the same word as the blows.
explanation.definitionFit: Handcuffs are called by this short name, and as a verb or plural noun it also means slaps or blows.

clue.text: Allurements, the cheerleaders' weapons

definitions.meaning: what cheerleaders use to win over a crowd: their looks and appeal

explanation.definitionFit: Attractive qualities that captivate, used by cheerleaders as their arsenal.

clue.text: Anticipate action of everybody south of Epping, say

indicators.note: in a down clue, south of puts the word for everybody beneath the other

parts.note: Epping Forest is a forest north-east of London
everybody is all

explanation.surface: Everyone living south of Epping is expected to act first.
explanation.walkthrough: Epping is a town, but 'say' asks for the forest it names, Epping Forest.
explanation.definitionFit: To forestall is to pre-empt someone by acting first.

clue.text: Republic in which university is buried in sandstorm

indicators.note: is buried in puts the university letter within the stormed letters
storm suggests the letters of sand are whipped about

explanation.surface: A country whose university disappears under a sandstorm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sandstorm' splits: 'storm' scrambles SAND into SDAN, and U goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: An African state south of Egypt, a republic.

clue.text: Head of early beast thrown back to reveal scales

indicators.note: being thrown back means the whole assembled string is read from right to left
the head of a word is its first letter, here of early

parts.note: a beast is an animal

explanation.surface: An early beast rears and tosses its head, revealing a scaly hide.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thrown back' turns E + ANIMAL as one run.
explanation.definitionFit: Thin layers or plates, as in rock, bone or a leaf, are this Latin plural.

clue.text: Marked and terrified — run inside!

indicators.note: inside tells us the run letter goes within the word for terrified

parts.note: terrified means scared
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A frightened, injured person is urged to get indoors fast.
explanation.definitionFit: Something left with a lasting blemish or wound mark has been marked.

clue.text: Delicate filly approaching track

parts.note: F is the racing abbreviation for filly
a railway track is a rail

explanation.surface: A fragile young mare nears the racecourse.
explanation.definitionFit: Weak and easily broken, so fragile in health or build.

clue.text: Brother has changed forenames

indicators.note: changed means the letters of forenames are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sibling has adopted new first names.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brother' seems to be a sibling, but members of this fraternal society call one another Brother.
explanation.definitionFit: Members of the Masonic lodges address each other as Brother.

clue.text: Gismo ran out of control, like a living thing

indicators.note: running out of control suggests the letters of gismo ran are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A gadget went haywire, as if it had a life of its own.
explanation.definitionFit: Any individual creature or plant is a life form.

clue.text: Cut — more traditional feature of the Oval

parts.note: a gash is a deep cut
older means more traditional

explanation.surface: A slash at something prized as an old-fashioned fixture of a cricket ground.
explanation.walkthrough: THE OVAL is a London cricket ground, overlooked by famous Victorian gas tanks.
explanation.definitionFit: The great Victorian gas storage tanks beside the Oval are a landmark.

clue.text: Locarno, for example, is said to be crowded

indicators.note: is said to be signals that the word for crowded is heard spoken

parts.note: crowded means packed

explanation.surface: A Swiss lakeside town is reported to be overrun with visitors.
explanation.walkthrough: Locarno looks like the Swiss resort, but here it is the 1925 treaty signed there.
explanation.definitionFit: The Locarno treaties of 1925 were an international agreement.

clue.text: Producing high-tension cable is a dangerous act

definitions.text: Producing high-tension cable is a dangerous act

parts.words: Producing high-tension cable is a dangerous act
parts.note: not electrical cable but a taut rope stretched high, the walk along which is a perilous circus act

explanation.surface: Making high-voltage cable is a hazardous job.
explanation.definitionFit: A taut, raised cord on which acrobats walk.

clue.text: Going by air, slower way of getting to Scotland

definitions.text: Going by air, slower way of getting to Scotland

parts.words: Going by air, slower way of getting to Scotland
parts.note: 'by air' means to the song's tune: Loch Lomond says the singer takes this road and the other gets to Scotland first

explanation.surface: Advice on travel to Scotland: flying, then a slower route.
explanation.walkthrough: In the Scottish song Loch Lomond, the singer taking this road is overtaken by the low road's traveller.
explanation.definitionFit: A main road, the one taken in the song that reaches Scotland later.

clue.text: This drawer might work on a block

definitions.text: This drawer might work on a block

parts.words: This drawer might work on a block
parts.note: a drawer is not furniture but one who draws, using a pad of paper

explanation.surface: A chest of drawers is designed to sit on a plinth.
explanation.definitionFit: An artist who makes quick drawings on a sketch block.

clue.text: River trial

definitions.meaning: a chalk-stream river in Hampshire, England
a trial is an examination of ability

explanation.definitionFit: Hampshire's famous trout river shares its name with an examination.

clue.text: Yellow bunting that flies around a place of isolation

definitions.text: Yellow bunting that flies around a place of isolation

parts.words: Yellow bunting that flies around a place of isolation
parts.note: not a yellow bird but a yellow banner hoisted over a ship or hospital in quarantine

explanation.surface: A yellow songbird flutters about a lonely spot.
explanation.definitionFit: A yellow signal flown to warn of infectious disease aboard ship or ashore.

clue.text: Pickle skin?

definitions.meaning: a pickle is a predicament or fix
to skin a knee is to graze it

explanation.definitionFit: Both an awkward fix and a graze to the skin.

clue.text: Mail-boat makes a tidy sum

definitions.meaning: a ship that carried post on a regular route
a tidy sum is a large amount of money

explanation.definitionFit: A regular mail ship was called this, and the word also means a lot of money.

clue.text: Dilatory sort finds convenience in a school break

indicators.note: in places the toilet letters within the scrambled school letters
break suggests the letters of a school are broken up and reassembled

parts.note: a convenience is a toilet, WC for water closet

explanation.surface: A dawdler gets to the toilet during school break time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'break' shuffles A SCHOOL into SLOOACH, and WC goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who lags behind and dawdles is a laggard.

clue.text: An amount on the bill for a shrub .

parts.note: a sum is an amount
on the bill means charged on account, abbreviated AC

explanation.surface: A garden centre puts a bush on the invoice.
explanation.definitionFit: A bush with red berries and bright autumn leaves.

clue.text: One in diplomacy should be understood

indicators.note: in places the numeral within the word for diplomacy

parts.note: diplomacy is tact
one is I, the Roman numeral

explanation.surface: A rule for diplomats: some things should go unsaid.
explanation.definitionFit: Implied without being said, as with an unspoken agreement.

clue.text: Instrument used in Purcell opera

indicators.note: used in shows the answer is found within the words Purcell opera

explanation.surface: Which instrument features in a Purcell opera?
explanation.definitionFit: A large bowed string member of the violin family.

clue.text: Street-urchin having fun with dirt

parts.note: mud is wet dirt
a lark is a bit of fun

explanation.surface: A child of the streets enjoys playing in the muck.
explanation.definitionFit: Originally someone scavenging the Thames mud, later any ragged street child.

clue.text: New hotel? Behold the famous moor!

indicators.note: new suggests a fresh arrangement of the letters of hotel

parts.note: lo is an old word for behold

explanation.surface: Tourists at a new hotel are shown a celebrated stretch of open heathland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moor' suggests heathland, but it is the Moorish general of Shakespeare's play; 'New' rearranges HOTEL as OTHEL.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's tragic hero is the Moor of Venice.

clue.text: Plague in dog quarters

parts.note: a cur is a mongrel dog
S and E are compass quarters, south and east

explanation.surface: Disease breaks out in the kennels.
explanation.definitionFit: To plague someone is to afflict them, as a hex or affliction does.

clue.text: Historic house wine bearing red and white label?

parts.note: the Tudors were a historic royal house of England
rose (rosé) is a pink wine

explanation.surface: A stately home sells its own wine with a red and white sticker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'house' looks like a stately building but is a royal dynasty; their emblem combined the red rose of Lancaster and the white of York.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tudor emblem joins red and white petals, so it serves as a heraldic badge.
